items.title: Weta FX and TAICCA Partner to Turn Taiwan Into an AI Screen Production Hub for Asia
items.excerpt: Weta FX and Taiwan's TAICCA will unveil a partnership at TCCF on Nov. 6 spanning co-investment, AI R&D and talent development, aiming to make Taiwan an AI screen-production hub for Asia.

items.title: Ancestral Memory Meets AI in Himalayan Drama 'Shirjara: Song of Grandmother' at Tokyo Gap-Financing Market
items.excerpt: Bikash Subedi's Nepali drama 'Shirjara: Song of Grandmother', which weaves AI into a story of ancestral memory, is pitching at the Tokyo Gap-Financing Market.

items.title: AI Dubbing Pioneer Flawless Sells Tech To Steven Schuurman Venture
items.excerpt: Flawless, the British company that spent $100 million building SAG-AFTRA-endorsed AI visual-dubbing technology (TrueSync, used on 'Fall'), has sold its IP to a venture backed by Steven Schuurman.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Discusses AI As Agency Weighs In On NYT Vs. OpenAI Battle
items.excerpt: CAA filed in the New York Times v. OpenAI training-data case with major stars on board, and Bryan Lourd laid out the agency's position on what AI should be allowed to train on and pay for.

items.title: WME Joins New York Times Copyright Battle Against OpenAI
items.excerpt: WME has joined the NYT v. OpenAI copyright fight, saying it doesn't object to AI but wants licensed, consent-based AI for its clients and creators.

items.title: Ava DuVernay Defends Using AI in New Doc '14th'
items.excerpt: DuVernay used AI to bring archival photographs to life in her new documentary and says she wants audiences to make their own decisions about the technology.

items.title: View Conference Was Inspiring: The AI Sales Pitches Were Exhausting (And Occasionally Bullshit)
items.excerpt: At Turin's View Conference, filmmakers shared their craft while AI evangelists insisted every animation and VFX studio already uses the technology. A report on how the AI pitches landed with artists.

items.title: Rough Cuts on a Freelancer's Clock - Understanding Adobe Premiere's AI tools
items.excerpt: A freelancer's walkthrough of using Premiere's AI tools in sequence for rough cuts. They won't make the creative calls, but they shrink the assembly part of the job.

items.title: After Effects Portal October 2026
items.excerpt: Monthly roundup of After Effects features, AI tools, freemium competitors and third-party plug-in news for motion designers and compositors.

items.title: iZotope Intros Photon for AI-Powered Stem Separation and Denoising
items.excerpt: iZotope's Photon is a standalone app and ARA plug-in that uses 12 custom-trained machine-learning models to separate stems and clean up dialogue for post-production, running locally on the GPU.

items.title: Remington Scott to Lead Eros Innovation's New AI Creative Unit
items.excerpt: Eros Innovation launched an AI creative unit for VFX, digital humans and gaming, led by Emmy-nominated producer/director Remington Scott ('Spider-Man 2'). One of its first projects revives singer Mohammed Rafi. (Partly an exec-move story; the curator should judge it.)

items.title: ByteDance Is Rewiring Its AI Video Bet
items.excerpt: ByteDance is consolidating its AI video products: the CapCut unit folded Xiaoyunque into Jimeng but kept Xiaoyunque's features, reshaping its AI video-creation lineup.

items.title: Seven directors to unveil AI short films at Seoul Independent Film Festival
items.excerpt: For SIFF's new 'AI Cinema Special' section, seven established directors including Lee Myung-se each teamed with AI creators (via Creative Mango) to make a short film. The shorts premiere when the festival opens Nov. 25. (Off-list: Yonhap gave it only one paragraph.)

items.title: 'Vibe Directing,' Hybrid Filmmaking and Robots: Disney's Startup Program Goes All-In on AI
items.excerpt: At Disney Accelerator Demo Day, the all-AI cohort, including AI-native studio Promise and OpenArt, showed 'vibe directing' and hybrid live-action/AI filmmaking tools. (Off-list: on-list trades had no coverage.)

items.title: Prompt, action, cut! Here comes Keralam's first full-length AI feature film
items.excerpt: 61-year-old first-time filmmaker Shane Sadanandan made the Malayalam feature 'Googilil Illaatha Oridam' entirely with AI tools, starting from Google Gemini prompt-writing, and is preparing its release. (Off-list.)
